message: I was rummaging through my closet the other day and stumbled upon my old go-bag. You know, the one I packed during that brief moment of panic after watching a documentary about emergency preparedness—complete with snacks, water, and even a cozy blanket! 😂 I chuckled at myself, but then I thought, isn’t it nice to feel a little more ready for whatever life throws our way? Sometimes, being gloriously over-prepared can bring a sense of calm in the chaos. What’s something you keep on hand just in case?
